text: Yetunde's choir concert is Nov 14, she's got a solo and is properly nervous about it. Text her good luck that morning.
coffee w emre. his daughter ioana has her first piano recital sometime in december, he's more nervous than she is lol
Lior ran the half marathon on Sunday, 1:52, absolutely buzzing. Kept saying he wants to do a full one in the spring.
Rahul and Claire are going to the Arctic Monkeys gig at the O2 on 3/21. Claire's never been to a big arena show before.

so I was just on the phone with Asha and um her brother Pieter is playing in the regional chess tournament next month and she says he's been practising every night, and their mum is flying over for it the day before, Asha's picking her up from the airport. I should ask her how he got on afterwards.
Hana - allergic to tree nuts, does pottery on Thursdays, hates musicals.
Need to buy stamps and return the library books before Friday.
Eduardo's band has a gig at The Lexington June 3rd. Said he'd put me on the list. Ask him the week before to confirm.
Kalani's play got cancelled, the theatre flooded. She's gutted, they'd rehearsed for months. Check in on her this weekend.
Adebayo mentioned his dad's 70th is sometime after Christmas, they haven't picked a date yet. He loves jazz, old vinyl especially - gift idea?
Helen's son Obi has his grade 5 trumpet exam on May 9, she's a wreck about it, he's totally chill. Wish him luck the day before.
Bao's moving to Leeds in the new year, starting at the uni hospital. Wants to do a leaving thing soon.
mandla match sat 10/4 hes captain now!! taking his little bro mustafa w me
Emeka - ran into him at the station. Wife Nadia is expecting, due around Easter. He's still at the council, planning dept.
Arturo's ballet showcase was last night. Forgot to ask how it went - message him tomorrow.
Farid said the dog Pepper went missing yesterday, they found her this morning in a neighbour's shed. Kids were in bits.
Victor & Laura got engaged!! Engagement party is Oct 31, fancy dress. I'm going as a pumpkin obviously.
Agnieszka's going through a rough patch, her mum's back in hospital and she's been doing all the driving. Ring her early next week.
Hoang's a massive F1 fan, goes to Silverstone every summer. Supports McLaren. Might be good for his birthday on Aug 2.
Dinner with Chen and his sister Uma. Uma's just started a PhD in marine biology, Chen's training for the Manchester 10k on 5/24. He wants a running watch, keeps dropping hints.
Mia's dance competition in Blackpool is the weekend of Feb 7. Her mum's driving them up the day before and staying in a B&B.
note to self: dentist moved to next Tuesday, 9:15
Yusuf has a trial for the county under-16s soon, maybe late November. His dad Mr Walsh told me he hasn't been sleeping well with the nerves.

Ilse got into the orchestra!! She'd auditioned twice before and not got in so this is huge for her. First rehearsal is Jan 12, first actual concert sometime in the spring, probably April. Her husband Arturo is already planning to bring the whole family. Must send her a card and maybe a bottle of something fizzy.
talked to rahul about his mum, she's had a fall and broke her wrist, he's going up to see her this weekend. sounds exhausted
Claire Hughes - new neighbour, two cats, Miso and Tofu. Works nights at the hospital, so keep it quiet before noon.
Lior Kim ("Kimmy") is doing stand up at an open mic on Thursday. First time ever. Go and support, and bring Hana if she's free.

Okay so lunch with Yetunde and Emre today. Yetunde's sister has her wedding on July 18th in Lagos, they're flying out the week before and staying two weeks after. Emre is doing the speech at his best mate's wedding the same month and is panicking about it. He asked if I'd read through a draft sometime next week. Also Yetunde's started learning the guitar.
Booked flights for the Lisbon trip, out April 2 back April 9.
Pieter's swim meet was Saturday - he won the 100m backstroke! Text him congrats.
Eduardo said his partner Asha is doing her driving test sometime in the new year. Not mentioning it to her, she's touchy about it.
Bao and Kalani's housewarming is Nov 22. I'm doing the dessert. Kalani said they need a doormat and a decent corkscrew.
Adebayo's wedding anniversary is 9/12, 10 years. His wife Helen loves orchids.
spoke with nadia briefly she's doing the great north run again next year, raising money for the hospice that looked after her dad
Must call Obi about the football tickets before Wednesday.
Mustafa auditioned for the youth theatre on Monday, hears back in a fortnight. Ask him how it went once he knows.

Victor's grandad passed away last week. Funeral is on Nov 6 at 11 at the crematorium in Hendon, wake afterwards at his aunt's. Victor's holding it together but only just, he was really close to him, used to go to every Spurs home game with him. Send flowers the day before and check in a few days after.
Laura - vegetarian, gluten free. Into bouldering and sea swimming. Her boyfriend Farid is the opposite, all burgers.
Yusuf told me his school's doing Grease in the spring and he's playing Danny. Rehearsals three nights a week already.
Arturo's uncle is retiring at the end of the month after 35 years at the post office. Big do at the social club on 11/28.

So Mia called, um, her nan's having a hip replacement on the 2nd and Mia's going to stay with her for a week after to help out. She also mentioned her boss is being a nightmare at the moment. I should drop round with soup that weekend, and maybe text her the day of the op.
Hana's cello recital moved from the 15th to Dec 3. She's dreading it, hasn't played in public in years.
Emeka and his brother Chen are running a pub quiz for charity sometime in Jan, they want me on a team.
gym w farid. knee still bad after the 5 a side, physio says 6 wks off. moaning about missing the derby on the 30th
Ioana's exhibition opening is Thursday, 7pm. Her parents are coming down from Cluj for it. Get her something small - she likes those dried flower bouquets.
Need to renew passport sometime this month, it expires in March.
Agnieszka mentioned her daughter is doing her first ever cross country race on Saturday morning. Agnieszka's more nervous than her.

Uncle Pieter has his cataract op on Jan 8, Aunt Ilse will drive him there and back. He's acting like it's nothing but Ilse says he's been quietly worried, he's never had surgery before. They can't drive for a bit afterwards so offer to do the shopping run that week, and maybe ring him the next day to see how he's doing.

mandla's band playing the student union on 12/5 then hes off on tour round germany for three weeks the next day. first proper tour, van and everything. his girlfriend uma is not thrilled about him being away over her birthday but she's coming out to see the berlin show. get tix for the SU gig before they sell out
Hoang and his wife Asha are celebrating their 5th anniversary in Paris in the spring, keeping the dates secret even from his mum lol.
Victor 'Vic' Moreau - plays sax in a wedding band, weekends mostly. Lives in Walthamstow with his partner and two kids.
right so the race got called off because of the storm, Lior's gutted, he'd been tapering for weeks. He's going to do the one in Brighton in March instead. Text him in a bit.
Grocery run tomorrow, then sort out the boiler service.

Claire was telling me at pickup that her daughter has her ballet exam on June 3rd and her son's got a football tournament in Reading the same weekend, both early starts. Her husband's away with work that week so she's going to be split in two and is stressing already. Offer to take one of them, probably the tournament.
Rahul's been feeling low since the redundancy, not really leaving the house. He used to love five-a-side. Invite him to Thursday's game.
Kalani's nephew got a place at the conservatoire! Starts in September. Whole family is over the moon.
Yetunde said the gig on Friday was amazing, the band played her favourite song as the encore. She's obsessed with Afrobeats at the moment.

Met Laura's mum at the party. Lovely woman, retired teacher, mad about gardening, grows her own chillies. Laura's birthday is March 14 - her mum said she wants a proper hiking backpack because she's planning to do the West Highland Way in the summer with her friend Bao. Maybe chip in with Farid?
Mustafa & Nadia - competing in the salsa championship in Birmingham on 4/18. Practising every day after work. Ask them a few days after how they placed.
Long day, nothing much to note. Maybe watch the match later.
